title: DECE LE 2026 Bihar Diploma Lateral Entry Result/ Rank Card: Out Now BCECEB DECE
intro: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Borad (BCECEB)  has Officially Released Result/ Rank Card for Diploma Entrance Competitive Examination-Lateral Entry (DECE-LE) Examination 2026.  Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to DECE LE 2026 Admission. Exam Held On May 23-24, 2026 & Result/ Rank Card Released On June 4, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Result/ Rank Card Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: Online Apply Start On : 20 March 2026
Last Date For Apply Online : 27 April 2026
Last Date  for Online Fee Payment: 27 April 2026
Online Editing-Application Form: 29-30 April 2026
Admit Card Available on: 11 May 2026
Exam Date : 17 May 2026
Result/ Rank Card : 04 June 2026
General/ BC/ EBC Candidates : Rs. 2200/-
SC/ ST/ PH Candidates: Rs. 2200/-
All Female Candidates: Rs. 2200/-
Payment Mode: Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking Fee Mode
Minimum Age:  Not Required
Maximum Age:  Not Required
Intermediate (12th) Science Pass (Physics and Chemistry as Compulsory Subject and along with as one of Mathematics/ Biology Subject) OR
Intermediate (12th) Science Pass (with Mathematics Subject) OR
Intermediate (12th) Science Pass (with Vocational/ Technical Subject) OR 10th+ ITI
The examination will be conducted in offline mode.
The paper will contain three sections: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
Each subject will have 50 questions carrying 200 marks.
The total number of questions will be 150 and the total marks will be 600.
The question paper level will be based on Intermediate (10+2) Science.
Questions will be available in English along with Hindi translation.
Read the official prospectus for complete syllabus and detailed exam instructions.
